name: reserved-template-names
body: `deck`, `slide`, `item`, `raw`, `data`, `table`, `tables`, `notes` and `body` are reserved template names, and `_format` is a reserved field-name suffix. A `template.yaml` that declares a field or a section named any of those, or a field whose name uses the `_format` suffix beyond the documented number/date format mechanism, is a templates error. The reserved names carry framework data and are unavailable to template authors.
